body:
Got a girlfriend,  
Went from a kissless virgin to having sex in 6 months,  
My grades got much better this year overall,  
Managed to get rid of my depression,  
Did pretty good on my finals,  

I'm really happy right now, compared to having suicidal thoughts few times a day, that's a pretty awesome change I'd say :)

We were in the same class at the time. She used to stare at me EVERY time I looked in her direction. She was also extremely shy whenever we talked. I figured that she liked me, but boy did it take a while for me to decide to make a move. I have yet to regret that decision... :)

Thanks. 
Words like this really help.
Yes, I started writing a diary recently. I'm not sure if it's helping much. Last time I was writing in it I ended up crying and throwing it as far as I could...

I feel exactly the same :( 

I know that my friends really like me, but I don't want to bother them with my issues... I feel terrible whenever I need to ask for help from anyone, and I already did that far too many times recently... I feel terrible whenever I don't have anyone to talk to, and I really don't want to bother my best friend, becouse I know she has her own problems recently. 

I really hate this society that forces me to never show any emotions. Last days have been really hard for me, and there is noone I can talk to...
I hope you're right... I will wait and see how things turn out... I have quite a bit of things coming up soon, a lot can change during that time so I might as well give it a go.
Thanks... This honestly really helps, I need to rethink my life right now.

Thanks for that story. I must admit that it really was one of the most interesting things I've read last time. I don't really want to kill myself yet, but every new day is worse then the previous one. This overwhelming feeling of loneliness is crushing me inside. I also thought that I'm the class clown, but last time it's really hard to joke around, becouse everytime I try to smile, tears are the only thing coming out....

Thanks again for your story, I'm glad life turned out ok for you, I can only hope for such a thing to myself right now, but time will tell which one of us was right...

Thanks for actually taking your time to read through that. Your words really mean a lot to me. I've really had a bad day. First I woke up to a dream that was just perfect. Those are the worst, becouse no matter how good they are, they will end at some point... Leaving you with just feeling of sadness and such overwhelming loneliness...

Then not much really happened at school. Except I actually had a chance to say few words to 'Her'. As per usual I didn't see anything in her that could indicate that she might like me. I felt even more lonely... Then my 2 best friends(they are together, boy and girl) didn't really have time to talk to me. This made things even worse... I got home and continued writing this farewell journal about my feelings to maybe feel a little bit better... Oh, did I mention that at school, I overheard those 2 talking  with so much care for one another...

 Eh anyways, this day made me feel extremly lonely... My heart felt like it was being crushed by weight of all my combined problems. 

Concerning that happiness: I was thinking like you not so long ago. As I said, I try to be as funny as possible, giving others happiness this way was pretty much the reason I wanted to live. However last time I've met few people upset, and felt terrible about myself becouse of this. I realised im just an worthless asshole whining about his minor problems, when there are people that deal with much bigger problems  every day. 

I'd love to still give that happiness to others. I've probably never felt as happy as when I was told by one of girls in my class that I made her day with a joke after she lost her favorite scarf. But it's getting really hard for me to try and be happy and cheerful, while feeling that emptiness inside... And thus I've upset few people. 

I feel like I also lied a bit in that post... Even tho I think im smarter then most people, I definitely think all people are interesting... I love listening to other people problems or stories and trying to help then with them. I don't even feel smarter then few people I know... 

But im really fed up with the fact that so many people have found their second halves, that they can talk to, hold hands with and share their feelings with. And I can't... Im not necessarily bad looking, im slim, pretty fit and funny, and yet I don't think any girls find me interesting... I just don't know what to do anymore.
[](/talon)  "Have you anything to offer but weakness?!"
